method.corridor_rule: a cut gate with an end whose raster cell and 8 neighbours all carry another region, and that is more than corridor_km from its raster border or still has an end on the wrong side after anchoring, is a corridor gate and is not anchored

properties.note: Display/versioning aid; borders pass through every cut and river gate. Authoritative region = node_region table via the snapped road node (region_lookup.py).
